## Commands

The `check_change.sh` hook reads the fenced block below. Keep the `key: value` format; one line per key. Leave the value empty when the status is not `verified`.

```standard
unit: <command>
integration: <command or empty>
lint: <command>
format: <command or empty>
source_paths: <space separated paths that hold application code, e.g. app src>
test_paths: <space separated paths that hold tests>
changelog: CHANGELOG.md
```

| Slot | Status | Evidence | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| unit | verified / unverified: <reason> / missing | <file:line> | <duration, n tests> |
| integration | ... | ... | <prerequisites: DB, env vars, args> |
| lint | ... | ... | |
| format | ... | ... | |

- Conventions: <fixtures, base classes, mocking library, data folders>
